concepts.title: Numbers Tell Us Things
concepts.definition: Numbers can carry hidden stories: a list of numbers may encode children standing by height, distances walked, or a secret rule, and reading the pattern behind the numbers uncovers the situation.
concepts.key_idea: Numbers are coded descriptions: behind every mysterious list hides a rule worth hunting.
question_patterns: what could the numbers in the given figure describe
make your own set of numbers that tells a story
how do you check a guessed rule behind numbers
decode the pattern your teacher writes on the board
why can one number list fit more than one story
write a puzzle where classmates guess what numbers mean

concepts.title: Number Games and Their Patterns
concepts.definition: Number games attach rules to values: saying a word instead of certain multiples, guessing a hidden number from clues, or following a move-rule on digits, each game trains the habit of testing a rule case by case.
concepts.key_idea: A rule is only understood when tested on many cases: games make testing fun and automatic.
question_patterns: play the given number game and state its rule
which numbers get the special word in the game
guess the hidden number from the given clues
make a number game with a rule of your own
why do some numbers break the pattern in a game
explain the rule to a friend using five examples

concepts.title: Patterns in Arrangements of Numbers
concepts.definition: Arranging numbers in rows, grids or chains exposes patterns: diagonals share sums, neighbours differ by fixed steps, and predicting the next arrangement is a matter of spotting the repeating rule.
concepts.key_idea: Arrangement is analysis: the same numbers placed in a grid speak patterns that a list hides.
question_patterns: find the next row of the given number arrangement
what pattern do the diagonals of the grid show
complete the number chain using its rule
make a magic-like arrangement where rows share a sum
why does arranging numbers reveal hidden patterns

concepts.title: Reasoning with Number Clues
concepts.definition: Number puzzles give clues like bigger than, even, or digit sum, and each clue cuts the possibilities; systematic elimination, not guesswork, lands on the answer.
concepts.key_idea: Every clue is a filter: apply them in order and the answer has no room left to hide.
question_patterns: guess the two digit number from the given clues
which clue narrowed the possibilities the most
list all numbers satisfying bigger than 40 and even
make a clue puzzle for the number 36
why should clues be applied in order
check whether your answer obeys every clue
